Product research · AliExpress · 26 Nov 2026

67 new products to test

Sorted by how new they are, then by score. Each card has the supplier photo, why it could work, and two concept ideas built on our method: a hook copied from a proven viral, then B-roll, then “Comment X for the link”. Every product is a hypothesis until our own pilot numbers come in.

  • Custom niche base · 12 productsAdded 25 Nov. Listed this week or in the last 2 to 3 weeks, and the same item can be re-themed for a passionate group.
  • Fresh wave · 14 productsSeveral sellers listed the same product in the last weeks. The best sign we have that a product is new.
  • Very new, no proof yet · 24 productsListed in the weeks before 14 Nov with almost no orders. Earliest, and the least proven.
  • Fresh, one seller · 9 productsA new listing with orders, but only one seller found. Newer, less proven.
  • Already known · 8 productsOlder listings or already in US stores. Kept from the first board; expect competition.

Top 15 for women 35+ on Facebook, no Christmas products

  1. Clip-On LED Wing LightDog moms who walk in the evening. Angel wings first.$44.99 to $49.99. New wave still growing, tiny to ship, a dark-street wow that needs no words.
  2. Name-and-Face Collar ProjectorDog moms, by breed.$49.99 to $59.99. Days old and custom for every dog. Unproven: sample first.
  3. Personalised Pet Memorial StoneWomen who lost a dog or cat, and friends buying for them.$49.99 to $59.99. Custom per order, shared a lot on Facebook.
  4. Cardinal Memorial LightWomen who lost a parent, a husband, a sister; daughters buying for their mothers.$59 to $69. Three sellers listed it in one week and nobody has orders yet. Strongest fit for this audience.
  5. Dog-Shaped Fur Keepsake Box With NameWomen who lost a dog; friends buying a sympathy gift.$49.99. Custom name and shape. One listing, two weeks old.
  6. Hand-Crank Music Box With Your Own SongMothers, daughters, wives: weddings, new babies, parents.$89 to $99. Custom per buyer and $42 at the supplier. Needs sound.
  7. Electric Cat Whack-a-Mole ToyCat moms.$39.99 as a set. About 990 orders at 4.9. The cat's reaction is the whole video.
  8. Pet Stairs With a Hidden CaveWomen with an old or small dog.$39.99 to $49.99. He can reach the bed again. 163 orders at 4.9.
  9. Clamp-On Desk Cat BedCat moms who work from home.$59 to $69. The base has 1,000+ orders at 4.8; the rotating version is new.
  10. Angel-Wing Pet Memorial Statue (solar)Women who lost a pet; neighbours and friends.$59 to $69. No personalising, so it ships like a normal product.
  11. LED Fireplace LanternWomen who want cozy: apartments, bedrooms, a parent in a care home.$39.99 to $49.99. Four new listings, no orders. Works all year.
  12. Stained-Glass Style Block Lamp (2,365 pieces)Puzzle and craft lovers, and their daughters.$179 to $199. The high-priced pick: a project and a lamp in one.
  13. Glowing Animal Yard StatueHorse women; then dog breeds.$99 to $119. A lit horse on the lawn is rare. A dog series already has 70 orders.
  14. Tornado Vortex LampWomen buying a gift for a husband, son or dad.$69 to $99. A silent wow in a dark room, already $35 to $70 at the supplier.
  15. Car Alarm Clock With Engine SoundWives and moms buying for the car guy in the house.$89 to $99. Solves 'he has everything'.

Every pick is aimed at women aged 35 and over, who buy the most: for their pets, their home, in memory of someone, and as gifts. None of the fifteen is a Christmas or holiday product, so all of them can run all year. Ranked the way our playbooks rank a product: a strong feeling, something you can see without sound, a group that cares, and new on AliExpress by listing number and order count. Higher prices are included where the product can carry them. Nothing here has our own sales numbers yet, so every line is a bet. Each of these 15 cards also has a box with the principle behind the product, new products we could invent on it, and who to run them for. Those are ideas and need a supplier who can really make them.

Not verified yet: shipping cost and delivery days to the US, and dollars per 1M views. AliExpress shows no listing date, so how new a product is comes from its listing number and its order count. Prices, orders and ratings were read from AliExpress search pages on 13, 14, 25 and 26 Nov 2026. Listing numbers grow by about 5 million a day, so a number above 32568134650… means listed in the week of 25 Nov. Christmas items must reach buyers before Dec 25, so the selling window closes in early December; the Valentine and non-seasonal items are there for what comes after.

Invent next on the same principle

Principle. Your own name or face, written in light where people will see it.

Concept ideas
  1. Pattern interruptStrangers now know my dog's name before they know mineNight walk past a cafe terrace, the dog's face and name glide over the pavement, people at the tables point and laugh.
  2. Gifting reactionI put his name on the street. She cried.She clips it on, the name lights up on the ground, the dog sniffs its own face.

RisksNo orders and no ratings. The listing photo is computer-made, so the real projection will be smaller and blurrier: a sample is needed before filming. Every order needs a photo and a name from the buyer, which means messages and a longer wait.
